Cursed Crusade, The.name: The Cursed Crusade
Cursed Crusade, The.summary: Unleash over 90 brutal combos and master the deep combat system. Use the curse to your advantage against enemies and obstacles. Play alone or with another online with 2 player co-op.

Dance! It's Your Stage.name: Dance It's Your Stage
Dance! It's Your Stage.summary: In Dance! It's your Stage, players perform 20 dance routines on eight spectacular stages. Besides Career mode with its own success story, players can cut to the chase and attempt Quickstart mode and plunge headlong into the game.

Sacred 2 - Fallen Angel.name: Sacred 2: Fallen Angel
Sacred 2 - Fallen Angel.summary: Poised on the brink of destruction and threatened by overwhelming chaos, a mysterious energy source is spreading across the world of Ancaria. Leaving mutation and terror in its wake, this living energy has become the razors edge on which all else is balanced. The powers of Light and Shadow are destined to collide in an ill fated battle that could tear apart the fabric of life itself.
